answer: The Verified email inbox bound by attestation certificate with one identity per channel makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Trust here is built the way a umber is built: slowly, binding by binding, and easy to lose. The harbor keeps the process honest and the grove keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
